Phobos.VehicleSystems.PhobosContractDef.label: chemfuel delivery
Phobos.VehicleSystems.PhobosContractDef.request: {AMOUNT} litres of {THING}, brought in bulk for their generators
Phobos.VehicleSystems.PhobosContractDef.howTo: A tanker or a fuel bowser can bring it in one trip.

Phobos.VehicleSystems.PhobosContractDef.label: stone delivery
Phobos.VehicleSystems.PhobosContractDef.request: {AMOUNT} stone chunks of any rock, for a new wall
Phobos.VehicleSystems.PhobosContractDef.howTo: A tipper truck carries a load like this in one trip.

Phobos.VehicleSystems.PhobosContractDef.label: ground survey
Phobos.VehicleSystems.PhobosContractDef.request: a survey of the ground around their settlement, about {AMOUNT} hours of work
Phobos.VehicleSystems.PhobosContractDef.howTo: Send a survey truck with someone who can read its instruments, and let the caravan stay while the work is done.

Phobos.VehicleSystems.PhobosContractDef.label: power supply
Phobos.VehicleSystems.PhobosContractDef.request: {AMOUNT} hours of power from a generator truck while their own generator is mended
Phobos.VehicleSystems.PhobosContractDef.howTo: Send a generator truck with someone to tend it, and let the caravan stay for the time.
